scope: Closed program with exactly one external entry; original callee bodies and shared capped growth fuel. No independent-library export ABI.

oracles.reach: Reuse reachable-controls.json four wrapping-add input/output pairs; cycle is structural only, cap has257 functions and remains unchanged.
oracles.reset: Reuse every fixture=reset row in controls.json without changing its expected value.
oracles.many: Reuse the independent Phase106 campaign.expected many oracle and existing12 n=[0,1,2,9],seed=[0,23,4294967295] finite pairs.

checks: For every fixture budget0 returns deep-identical input, including unused definitions.
For each valid result require nx_verify and total nodes <= original nodes + min(budget,4096).
At4096 require exact keepAt4096 names in original order; reach_cap remains257 original definitions.
Check all direct NxCall and address NxFunc targets remain defined, including stored/returned function pointers.
Execute only finite fixtures, comparing complete scalar values with independent unchanged oracles and original program.
Invalid tail_dead remains exactly unchanged and is never executed.
Deep-compare many4096 against nx_reachable(nx_inline_entry(original,4096)); entry body should be identical.
For bounded budgets compare semantics, not universal byte equality to oldpolicy: skipping dead definitions changes where remaining fuel is spent.
Before a performance claim, record optimization/emission/object costs separately; require same retained many entry code and correct outputs.
Source review must establish every nx_i_function/nx_i_functions receives original_fs, and fuel returned from entry is passed to the remaining stage without reset.
limitations: Purity summaries still scan all original functions. Two pruning phases, not pruning after every helper. A reachable helper made dead during remaining-function optimization can still consume work. nx_reachable capacity refusal can retain extra definitions. No proof, source-check or timing result is asserted.
